description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories related to video captioning. There are 15 slices in total, each labeled with a specific category and its corresponding percentage. The categories include People Blogs (17.2%), How to Style (9.7%), Education (8.7%), Entertainment (13.9%), Music (2.3%), Autos Vehicles (4.8%), Pets Animals (3.9%), News Politics (4.3%), Science Technology (4.6%), Comedy (6.4%), Travel Events (6.4%), Gaming (6.4%), Sports (7.7%), Animation (4.6%), and Film (4.6%). The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered by size, with People Blogs being the largest and Music being the smallest.
